*   # Trump forms committee to investigate mortgage fraud allegations against Fed governor Lisa Cook

    [From finance.yahoo.com](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/article/trump-forms-committee-to-investigate-mortgage-fraud-allegations-against-fed-governor-lisa-cook-153243615.html)

    [![](https://assets.faireconomy.media/nfs/npd/2018/04/05/npd_00_13_06.v2.png)](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/article/trump-forms-committee-to-investigate-mortgage-fraud-allegations-against-fed-governor-lisa-cook-153243615.html)

    https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/article/trump-forms-committee-to-investigate-mortgage-fraud-allegations-against-fed-governor-lisa-cook-153243615.html

    President Trump has established a committee to investigate allegations against Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook, including mortgage fraud and whether her statements constituted legal "cause" for Cook's removal from the central bank. The president has tasked the committee with investigating whether Cook made false statements about two mortgages she took out. The group will report to him whether there is legal cause for Cook's removal. Trump fired Cook, the first Black woman to serve as a Fed governor, in August 2025, claiming she committed mortgage fraud by making misrepresentations on loan documents years before her ...
